answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil floods by rationing sponsorship. Each established account may vouch for only a few newcomers an epoch, and those signed edges collect in a public reef anyone can inspect. The newcomer must also file one original work sample, a compact marble later graders can replay against the archive. A rotating raven then pecks through sponsorship neighborhoods; if fresh keys share timing, phrasing, or a single patron, those edges are burned and the patron's future vouching quota shrinks. Farms stall when sponsors run out of scarce slots.
